target_definition: 1 when item/location total wastage cost in the next Monday-start week is >= training-only p75 (1596.2) of positive training weeks; otherwise 0
prediction_point: At the start of each prediction week, prior completed weeks only; target week calendar is known.
target_week_definition: Prediction row at week_start t predicts wastage aggregated during target_week=t+7 days.

feature_semantics.waste lags: prior observed weekly waste quantities/costs; zero-filled missing weeks
feature_semantics.demand lags: prior completed-order item quantities; zero-filled missing weeks
feature_semantics.calendar: target-week month and ISO week number

leakage_exclusions: wastage reason observed after the prediction point
threshold_selection: Validation F1 over probability cutoffs 0.05..0.95; model selection by validation PR-AUC, then validation F1; test not used for selection.
limitations: Generated synthetic data; weekly risk classification identifies association/predicted risk, not causal drivers. Burden thresholds refer to cost source units without currency definition.
